item: The offline evidence and custody verifiers print a bundle's own text escaped and cut, so a tampered file cannot draw a fake VERIFIED line
summary: A case_name or item_id holding a newline (or CR, ANSI escape, U+2028/2029, NEL, VT, bidi override) followed by VERIFIED : True printed a fake verdict above the real False. Every line now goes through console_safe (control/format/separator/surrogate/private/unassigned characters as fixed-width escapes, backslash doubled) and bundle fields through console_field (cut at 64 escaped characters with the count left out, so padding cannot soft-wrap a fake verdict to a row start; hex-only keys and hashes stay whole). Exit codes and verdict logic unchanged; security read passed. Release line: The offline evidence and custody verifiers now show text from a bundle escaped and shortened, so a tampered file can no longer print a fake VERIFIED : True line.
